instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the correct spelling of the word.

atoms.b: The hood is ((++attached atatched ahtached attacched)) to the raincoat.
atoms.finishSound: The hood is attached to the raincoat.

atoms.b: He competed for the ballet award in his age ((++category catagory cattegory cattagory)).
atoms.finishSound: He competed for the ballet award in his age category.

atoms.b: Can I ((++persuade purseade perswade persade)) you to come swimming with me?
atoms.finishSound: Can I persuade you to come swimming with me?

atoms.b: There is a ((++definite deffinite definet deffinette)) chance it will rain later.
atoms.finishSound: There is a definite chance it will rain later.

atoms.b: The hotel is ((++equipped ekwipped eqwipped ekuipped)) with an outdoor swimming pool.
atoms.finishSound: The hotel is equipped with an outdoor swimming pool.
